_comment: REAL reference case from this toolkit's own due-diligence pass on a real project-finance model (Unnic LNG, a 10-year LNG-bunkering term-loan facility model): EBIT and the ACTUAL cash tax the model deducted from an otherwise-unlevered free cash flow line. The tax was computed on Earnings Before Taxes (i.e. after deducting real interest expense) rather than on EBIT directly -- a real, verified $41,716 double-counted interest tax shield across the facility's 10-year life.
